visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a beige apron over a light-colored ribbed sweater in a bright, modern kitchen. She is focused on cleaning raw shrimp in a silver colander, using her hands to peel them. The background shows wooden cabinets and a white wall. (2) A close-up shot transitions to the surface of a silver induction cooktop. A hand enters the frame and presses the touch buttons on the control panel, turning the stove on. A large stainless steel pan is placed on the induction ring. (3) The camera shifts to a white rice cooker sitting on the kitchen counter. A hand lifts the lid to reveal steaming white rice. The woman uses a white rice paddle to scoop the fluffy rice into a black inner pot. (4) A close-up shows the woman testing the pan's temperature by splashing a few drops of water into the dry stainless steel pan; the water beads up and dances on the surface. She then pours clear oil from a white bottle and tilts the pan to coat the bottom. (5) The scene cuts to a small bowl on the counter. The woman cracks three white eggs, one by one, against the rim of the bowl and drops the yolks and whites inside. Two other eggs remain in a wire rack nearby. (6) Returning to the stove, she pours the whisked eggs into the hot pan. They immediately start to bubble and cook. She uses a large metal spoon to scramble them before adding the prepared grey shrimp into the mix. (7) A close-up shot shows her holding a large orange carrot over the pan. She uses a white peeler to shred thin strips of carrot directly into the cooking eggs and shrimp, adding a vibrant orange color to the dish. (8) The woman vigorously stirs the mixture with a metal spoon, ensuring all ingredients are evenly cooked. She then picks up a white electric grinder and seasons the food with freshly ground pepper or salt. (9) She adds the white rice from the pot into the pan. Using a white squeeze bottle, she pours soy sauce around the edges of the rice. Finally, she takes a handful of chopped green scallions from a plastic container and sprinkles them over the top. (10) The video concludes with several close-up shots of the finished shrimp fried rice being stirred and served. The dish looks colorful with green onions, orange carrots, yellow eggs, and pink cooked shrimp mixed with the golden-brown rice.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins speaking in a friendly, mid-pitched tone with clear articulation, explaining the decision to cook due to windy weather. There is no background music, only the faint hum of an indoor environment and the sound of hands moving. (2) A sharp mechanical click is heard as the induction stove is turned on, followed by several short beeps from the control panel. The speaker continues her narrative in a calm, moderate pace. (3) A splash of water hitting a hot metal surface produces a distinct, high-frequency sizzle that lasts for a second. This is followed by the hollow sound of a plastic lid being lifted and the soft scraping of a rice paddle. (4) Three rhythmic, sharp cracks occur as eggs are struck against a bowl, followed by the soft sound of liquid being poured. The narrative voice remains steady and professional, providing tips about using rice for fried rice. (5) A loud, continuous sizzle erupts as the eggs hit the hot oil in the pan. The sound of a metal spoon clinking against a stainless steel pan becomes prominent, creating a rhythmic percussive texture alongside the cooking sounds. (6) The sound of a peeler scraping against a carrot produces short, repetitive 'zip' sounds. This is layered with the ongoing sizzle of the pan and the narrator's voice discussing the 'egg crisis' and checking egg brands. (7) A series of metallic clinks and scraping sounds follow as the rice is added and stirred. The sound of a plastic bottle being squeezed and liquid splashing is heard, followed by the rustle of a plastic container lid and more stirring. (8) The audio concludes with a final summary from the narrator, whose tone becomes more satisfied and upbeat. The background noise of the pan subsides, leaving the clear, final words of the speaker about the benefits of home cooking.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a step-by-step tutorial for making shrimp fried rice at home while sharing personal reasons for avoiding delivery, emphasizing the cost-effectiveness and health benefits of home cooking.
